name: from_raw
declaration: unsafe fn from_raw (ptr : * mut c_char) -> CString
rules: The pointer passed to CString::from_raw must have been obtained earlier by calling CString::into_raw.
The string length recalculated by CString::from_raw must match the original length from the CString::into_raw call.
The CString::into_raw and CString::from_raw methods must not be used when passing the string to C functions that can modify its length.
